title: Myke Towers, Eladio Carrión, Greeicy & More Set for 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Lineup
summary: Lin-Manuel Miranda will be honored with the 2026 Corazón Latino Award.
contentText:
The 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina returns to Miami’s Kaseya Center on Oct. 17, Billboard can exclusively announce on Tuesday (July 21), as well as reveal its star-studded lineup.

This year, Myke Towers, Blessd, Farruko, Manuel Turizo, Eladio Carrión, FloyyMenor, Greeicy, Alleh and Cuban newcomers Rey Tony y Helabusador (aka Los Titis) form part of the lineup. Rey Tony y Helabusador, in collaboration with Ya Ice Dilan, are behind the ultra-viral reparto song “Dichavate” that was recently ranked No. 4 on Billboard’s Best Latin Songs of 2026 (so far) midyear list.

Hosted by iHeartLatino president and iHeartRadio personality Enrique Santos, this year’s annual concert will honor award-winning playwright, composer, actor and singer Lin-Manuel Miranda with the 2026 iHeartRadio Corazón Latino Award, celebrating his work both on and off the stage and for being “deeply committed to philanthropy and social impact,” reads the press statement.

Additionally, the Miami Fire-Rescue’s Florida Task Force 2—which was deployed by the State Department to assist the affected communities in Venezuela—will be recognized at the event for its heroic response to the devastating twin earthquakes that occurred in June.  

“iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina celebrates the music, culture and pride that bring our community together,” Santos shares. “This night is a celebration of the resilience and contributions of Latinos from every background. As we celebrate our 13th annual event, we’re proud to showcase Latin music’s biggest stars while honoring real-life heroes. Live from Miami, we’ll bring this celebration to Latin music fans across the country.”

Tickets for the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina, which will broadcast across iHeartRadio Latin stations nationwide, go on sale July 28 on Ticketmaster.
